english.title: Fail to comply with a duty under s.790G to notify company on becoming a PSC
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), knowing that you were a registrable

(A)_[person]_
(B)_[relevant legal entity]_

in relation to a company, namely **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..), failed, when the material in the register that was available for public inspection did not indicate your status as registrable and you had not informed the company of your status as a registrable

(C)_[person]_
(D)_[relevant legal entity]_

in relation to the company or had not given the company all your required particulars, to inform the company of that status and give the company the required particulars under section 790K of the Act within the required time limits
english.legislation: Contrary to section 790G of, and paragraph 14 of Schedule 1B to, the Companies Act 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
